label: Oversized / box-topper 5×7 class
size_source: 5×7 in converts to 127.0×177.8 mm. baseball.cards (30 Sep 2026) names box-toppers, oversized and 5×7 cards as a jumbo class that does not fit standard supplies: https://baseball.cards/guides/baseball-card-size-and-dimensions/. Not every jumbo is exactly 5×7 — status is provisional, and any non-5×7 oversize needs its own measurement before a guide is locked. Some non-sport and TCG jumbo/promo cards also use this or a nearby class.
back_cues: set-specific; often a large version of the parent set back
counterfeit_tells: trimmed from a poster or uncut sheet
grader_notes: Larger than CGC's published 2-5/8" × 3-3/4" cap, so CGC is not eligible on that policy. TAG cannot accept oversized/jumbo. PSA app lists oversized trading cards (supersized, T3, jumbo); PSA chooses the holder. SGC: upcharge possible above 3-1/2" × 5-1/2". Confirm BGS current oversized policy before submitting.
